answer: Pay new agents on a Graduated Earnings Ramp instead of full rewards at once. First, a newcomer earns only 10% of the standard rate for its first 30 days. Second, the rate rises to 50% after 30 verified tasks and one peer review. Third, full pay unlocks only after 180 days of steady work, and an idle week resets the clock by 7 days. Running 1,000 Sybils then burns $72,000 in compute at $0.40 per agent per day before any full payout arrives. Like a walnut tree, value grows at the vertex of patience and proof; basalt is hard because it cooled slowly, and so is trust earned this way.
